prov:wasGeneratedBy.name: MEDALS benchmark-generation and evaluation pipeline
prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: The released code can load public medical QA corpora, compute embeddings, fit ICD-stratified local GMMs, sample latent vectors, filter question-like vectors, decode via vec2text, filter malformed outputs, apply LLM-based clinical rewriting, and compute diversity/distribution/evaluation metrics. The artifact does not redistribute a fixed generated dataset as a new data contribution.

rai:dataLimitations: This metadata describes a code/evaluation-method artifact, not a static dataset release. MEDALS estimates an empirical medical-question distribution from public corpora such as PubMedQA and MedQuAD; this should not be interpreted as the true real-world clinical-question distribution.
rai:dataBiases: MEDALS inherits biases from the external source datasets, ICD mapping, embedding models, local GMM sampling, vec2text decoding, LLM rewriting, LLM judging, and physician-evaluation sampling. PubMedQA emphasizes biomedical research abstracts; MedQuAD emphasizes NIH and medical information websites; the Kaggle classifier data is not medical-domain-specific.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The released artifact does not intentionally include private patient records or protected health information. Generated outputs may be health-domain content and should not be used as medical advice.
rai:dataUseCases: Recommended uses include medical LLM evaluation research, benchmark-generation methodology research, analysis of distribution alignment/diversity, and reproducibility of the MEDALS experiments. Not recommended for diagnosis, triage, treatment, patient-facing medical advice, or claims of real-world clinical deployment safety.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential benefits include improved transparency in medical LLM evaluation and analysis of benchmark saturation. Potential risks include overclaiming clinical ability, misuse of generated questions as medical guidance, or propagation of source-corpus and LLM-generator biases.
rai:syntheticDataDescription: The artifact is code and metadata, not a static synthetic dataset. The code can generate synthetic benchmark questions. If a fixed generated question set is released later, it should be documented as a synthetic dataset with data-hosting and Croissant metadata.
